title: Enhancing therapeutic outcomes with artificial intelligence for HR-positive, HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer.
authors: Gomez Marti, Juan Luis; Michaels, Elena; Nasrazadani, Azadeh; Wander, Seth A; Brufsky, Adam M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究AI数字病理系统指导乳腺癌CDK4/6抑制剂治疗，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制完全无关。
abstract: Cyclin-dependent kinase 4/6 inhibitors (CDK4/6i) are an integral first-line treatment for hormone receptor-positive metastatic breast cancer, though resistance eventually develops. In this issue of Cancer Cell, Fan et al. report results from LINUX, a randomized phase 2 trial applying an artificial intelligence digital pathology classification system to guide therapy after CDK4/6i progression.
abstract_zh: 细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶4/6抑制剂（CDK4/6i）是激素受体阳性转移性乳腺癌的一线治疗的重要组成部分，尽管最终会产生耐药性。在本期《癌细胞》中，Fan等人报告了LINUX试验的结果，这是一项随机2期试验，应用人工智能数字病理分类系统来指导CDK4/6i进展后的治疗。
